name: Ötztal Bike Days
beschreibung: The Ötztal Bike Days are the premier mountain biking highlight of the year. The programme includes guided tours, test rides of the latest bike models, an agility skills course, pump track races, and a lively Bike Expo. The event offers the perfect challenge for riders of every skill level.
kurzbeschreibung: The major mountain biking event featuring guided tours, bike tests, and exciting races in the Ötztal.
